  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Alvarado, to approve
  recommendation to introduce for first reading, proceed by title only, and waive reading in full of Ordinance
  No. 2022­603, as amended, to add to Section 10.20.050 that no person operating any automobile,
  motorcycle or other motor driven vehicle within the city shall engage in a speed contest, or sideshow or
  street racing as set forth under the California vehicle code.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Roa, Del Rio, Farfan, Alvarado
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Gomez
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0
